## Summary {#summary}

**Before you go**

- How regulation can be part of competitive strategy (value of earlier readiness).
- Hong Kong’s risk-based approach for small unmanned aircraft and the role of [Sandbox X](glossary.qmd#hong-kong-institutions-and-law).
- Permissions for advanced operations (including BVLOS), safety cases, and compliance investment.
- Digital traffic management (U-space/UTM) and building a phased regulatory roadmap.

**Takeaways**

- Advanced operations need prior permission and may face extra conditions under a risk-based framework.
- Sandbox X supports controlled testing and evidence—not a waiver of safety rules or automatic commercial approval.
- A safety case is an evidence-based argument for a defined operation; it may aid approval and insurability without guaranteeing cheaper premiums.
- Digital traffic-management services can cut coordination cost and support scale, but still need oversight, cybersecurity, and governance.
- A strong roadmap ties each new operating privilege to specified evidence, review, and risk controls.

## Readings {#readings}

### Main references

- [CAD, Small Unmanned Aircraft (Cap. 448G)](https://www.cad.gov.hk/english/sua.html) — Cap. 448G regulator page; full effect 1 December 2022; Category C ≤150 kg from July 2025.

  ::: {.callout-note collapse="true" appearance="simple" title="官方中英文本 · Official English and Chinese"}
  English: “Under the SUA Order that took full effect on 1 December 2022, SUA operations are regulated under a risk-based approach.”…“In July 2025, the scope of the SUA Order was expanded to cover SUA weighing not more than 150kg.” ([source](https://www.cad.gov.hk/english/sua.html))

  [「法例已於2022年12月1日全面實施，以風險為本的模式規管小型無人機的操作」…「於2025年7月， 《小型無人機令》的規管制度擴闊至重量不超過150公斤的小型無人機。」]{lang="zh-Hant"} ([source](https://www.cad.gov.hk/chinese/sua.html))
  :::

- [CAD AC-013](https://www.cad.gov.hk/documents/AC-013_E.pdf) — 31 December 2025. BVLOS inside the first Regulatory Sandbox.

  ::: {.callout-note collapse="true" appearance="simple" title="官方中英文本 · Official English and Chinese"}
  English: “Permission for Small Unmanned Aircraft Beyond Visual Line of Sight Operations within the Context of Regulatory Sandbox” ([source](https://www.cad.gov.hk/documents/AC-013_E.pdf))

  [「「監管沙盒」框架下小型無人機超視距操作許可」]{lang="zh-Hant"} ([source](https://www.cad.gov.hk/documents/AC-013_C.pdf))
  :::
